en.name: Hao Zhou
en.intro: Investigating how neural populations organize sensory information into structured representations.
en.researchIntro: My interests lie at the intersection of conscious access, working memory, and the geometry of neural population activity.
en.question1: How does sensory information become available for conscious report?
en.question2: How are individual items maintained and organized into sequences?
en.question3: How does neural population structure support the transformation from sensory input to memory?
en.affiliation: Center for Excellence in Brain Science and Intelligence Technology (Institute of Neuroscience), Chinese Academy of Sciences

zh.intro: 探索神经群体如何将感觉信息组织为具有结构的表征。
zh.researchIntro: 我关注意识通达、工作记忆与神经群体活动的表征几何之间的关系。
zh.question1: 感觉信息如何成为可以被意识报告的内容？
zh.question2: 独立的信息如何被维持，并组织为有序的序列？
zh.question3: 神经群体的表征结构如何支持从感觉输入到记忆的转化？
